title: PayPal - Sudden account freezes with little explanation or appeal path
clean_text: Sellers report PayPal freezing accounts and holding funds -- sometimes for 180 days -- after automated flags on certain products or sales patterns, often with no specific policy violation cited and decisions made in an unappealable "back office" process; one documented case involved roughly $40,000 held for six months after a suspension. PayPal weighs factors like account tenure, transaction history, business type, and dispute history before placing holds, with new sellers and higher-risk categories (electronics, tickets) most affected. PayPal settled with Maryland and 27 other states over customer service practices, agreeing to streamline its user agreement and pay $1.7 million in investigation costs. Reviewers also note that real effective fees, once FX markup and dispute costs are included, run well above the advertised headline rate.
